draft.title: Making biodiesel
card: Plant oils are triglycerides: esters made from glycerol (propane-1,2,3-triol) and three long fatty acid chains. Biodiesel is a mixture of methyl or ethyl esters of those fatty acids.
In transesterification, a triglyceride reacts with a short-chain alcohol, usually methanol or ethanol. The alcohol swaps places with the glycerol part of the ester.
One triglyceride and three alcohol molecules make three biodiesel ester molecules and one glycerol molecule. A catalyst, often a base such as sodium hydroxide, speeds up the reaction.

Biodiesel esters have long chains with an oxygen-containing ester group. Petrodiesel is a mixture of hydrocarbons only. Biodiesel is made from plants, which are renewable, while petrodiesel comes from crude oil.
draft.remember: Biodiesel is made by reacting a plant oil with an alcohol, giving fatty acid esters and glycerol.

a.q: Which pair of products forms when a plant oil reacts with methanol to make biodiesel?
a.why: Transesterification swaps the glycerol part of the triglyceride for methanol, so three methyl esters and glycerol form. Methyl esters and water is tempting, but water is the by-product of esterification from an acid and an alcohol, not of this reaction.
a.clue: The alcohol swaps places with the glycerol part.

b.q: A plant in Bendigo makes biodiesel from canola oil and ethanol. Which statement about the process and its products is correct?
opts: Each triglyceride makes three ethyl esters and one glycerol
Each triglyceride makes one ethyl ester and three glycerol
Each triglyceride makes three ethyl esters and three water
Each triglyceride makes one ethyl ester and one glycerol
b.why: A triglyceride has three fatty acid chains, so it needs three ethanol molecules and gives three ethyl esters plus one glycerol. Three ethyl esters and three water is tempting, but no water forms because the ester links are exchanged, not made from acids.
b.clue: Count the fatty acid chains on one triglyceride.

b.best: Each triglyceride makes three ethyl esters and one glycerol
